records.claim: Chinese refiners suspended October oil-product exports beyond Hong Kong and Macau, according to four sources cited by Reuters.
records.observation: A flexible source of gasoline, diesel and jet fuel is being withheld from external markets for October.
records.assessment: CONFIRMED DELTA with source caveat: physical-flow policy is reported by Reuters sources; no published Chinese directive was located.

records.claim: Bundesnetzagentur adopted MiSpeL, allowing electricity storage and bidirectional charging points to combine grid and renewable electricity under new market-integration rules, with a transition period through September 2027.
records.observation: A regulatory barrier to market-active mixed storage and bidirectional charging is removed, subject to implementation conditions.
records.assessment: CONFIRMED DELTA. The rule changes market access today; physical flexibility will propagate during implementation.

records.claim: Taiwan's cabinet approved a supplementary-budget plan including NT$180.935 billion to compensate energy-price absorption and NT$233.834 billion to recapitalise CPC so it can strengthen finances and continue infrastructure investment.
records.observation: The state is moving the external energy-price shock onto the public balance sheet while preserving utility and infrastructure capacity.
records.assessment: CONFIRMED DELTA at cabinet-approval stage; legislative approval remains necessary.

records.claim: The Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity reached consensus on the Milwaukee Framework for joint action on global steel excess capacity.
records.observation: Participants now have a shared framework for coordinated responses to excess capacity.
records.assessment: CONFIRMED DELTA in institutional coordination; no immediate physical steel-flow change is claimed.

records.claim: Fujairah fuel-oil imports rose to 2.6 million tonnes in the third quarter from 845,000 tonnes in the second, while inventories and bunkering remained below pre-war levels.
records.observation: Alternative supply and bunkering activity are recovering around the Hormuz constraint without restoring the pre-war state.
records.assessment: PERSISTENT / PROPAGATING. Stronger evidence of adaptation, not a fresh system delta.
